rules.selection_gate: Prefer direct official UFC UUID/FightMetric/event relationships. Never create a trusted fighter/fight identity from display-name-only matching.
rules.fallback_rule: Use lower-priority source only where official identity is absent and the fallback has its own stable provider identity plus a validated crosswalk.
rules.notes: Official UFC is the identity spine; Greco and ESPN remain redundancy/QA.

rules.selection_gate: Static identity fields may reconcile across sources; mutable current profile fields require dated snapshots and may not be backfilled into old fights.
rules.notes: Current rank/status/gym/listed weight are point-in-time observations, not historical truth.

rules.selection_gate: Official row must have stable fight identity, audited numeric corner mapping 0=red/1=blue, round>=1, a non-null mapped field, and no unresolved duplicate source version for that fighter-round key.
rules.fallback_rule: Greco supplies the value when official UFC is missing/ineligible. ESPN remains additive/QA until its grain/semantics are independently promoted.
rules.qa: On 32,342 uncontested aligned fighter-round keys, shared official-vs-Greco count fields are generally ~99.35%-100% exact; disagreements remain provenance-visible.
rules.duplicate_policy: For any conflicting FightMetric source-version key, do not choose first/last/newest automatically. Use Greco for shared count fields and quarantine official-only TIP fields until a dedicated duplicate resolver promotes a version.

rules.selection_gate: Require exact-seconds semantics. UFC archived fight_stat.control_time is not eligible for control_sec.
rules.notes: UFC archived control_time equals floor(Greco control seconds/60) in 97.45% of 23,876 aligned comparisons; it is coarse QA evidence, not exact seconds.

rules.selection_gate: Stable identified actual-round row; mapped raw value is integer 0..5; fighter-round key has no unresolved duplicate FightMetric source version. Values >5 are preserved raw but canonical-ineligible.
rules.precision_rule: Store the accepted raw integer as a floor-whole-minute bucket and interval bounds only; never synthesize an observed exact-second duration.
rules.era_rule: Coverage is source-observed missingness, not a reason to impute. TIP coverage is near-zero before 2013; strong for most fields from 2013 onward. ground_time is specifically incomplete and reaches 0% coverage in 2023-present, so preserve nulls.
rules.notes: The minimum 0..5 fraction among populated audited position fields is >99.6%; >5 anomalies fail closed.

rules.selection_gate: Resolve fighter identity; only use ranking observations strictly before the target information cutoff.
Resolve fighter identity and deduplicate UFC overlap before canonical insertion.
rules.notes: Companion fighter-profile career totals are 2021 snapshot data and cannot be historical backfill.

rules.selection_gate: Require actual fight-specific scale weight/attempt evidence from official UFC content. Current roster weight and UFC fight-node weight fields are not substitutes.
Require official judge identity and round score tied to a resolved fight/fighter. OCR-only totals are not canonical round scores.
rules.fallback_rule: UFC-DataLab OCR remains raw/QA-only; MMA Decisions is reference-only under the current conservative acquisition rule.
